cues: They called it coupling and repulsion.
Alleles that entered the cross together tended to stay together.
In nineteen ten Thomas Hunt Morgan, working with fruit flies, gave the real explanation: those genes sit on the same chromosome.
text: They called it coupling and repulsion. Alleles that entered the cross together tended to stay together. In nineteen ten Thomas Hunt Morgan, working with fruit flies, gave the real explanation: those genes sit on the same chromosome. He called it linkage.
